issue.title: everflow test should be executed on T0 topology

failure.body:
Everflow test cases are only executed on T1 due to topology marker only included T1 topology:

https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/everflow/test_everflow_testbed.py#L18
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/everflow/test_everflow_ipv6.py#L12

As result, some platforms that are only present as T0 role don't have everflow feature tested.

We need to update this test to be T0 executable (if not yet).

resolution.title: [EVERFLOW] Implement EVERFLOW test on T0 topo
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: bingwang <<EMAIL>>

### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #4685
lement EVERFLOW test on T0 topo.
The current everflow test set is only running on `T1` topo. This PR enable the test on T0 topo by adding setup and updating test code.

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

This test is to implement EVERFLOW test on T0 topo.

#### How did you do it?
1. Add setup for T0 testbed.
2. Update test code.

#### How did you verify/test it?
